trap.label: falso cognato
trap.wrong: Deontology stresses duties, meanwhile consequentialism stresses outcomes.
trap.right: Deontology stresses duties, whereas consequentialism stresses outcomes.
trap.why: Em português “enquanto isso/ao passo que” vira meanwhile por tradução literal; para contraste de ideias use whereas ou while.

fix.wrong: Duty matter whereas outcomes does not.
fix.right: Duty matters whereas outcomes do not.

fix.wrong: Whatever you choose is fine, whereas.
Whereas he stresses duties, she stress outcomes.
fix.right: Whereas he stresses duties, she stresses outcomes.

rewrite.prompt: Una com whereas: “Kant stresses duties. Mill stresses outcomes.”
rewrite.answer: Kant stresses duties, whereas Mill stresses outcomes.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com whatever: “Any choice is fine.”
